full_judgment: 2.  The respondent No. 1 as plaintiff instituted the aforesaid suit for partition of the suit-lands and for allotment of Saham in respect of his share on declaration of his title thereto. Plaintiffs case, briefly, was that the 1st schedule land of the plaint which includes the 2nd schedule-land belonged to the present defendant No. 1 Abdur Rahman and defendant No. 2 Md. Ilias jointly in equal shares which were recorded in the RS Khatian accordingly; that defendant No. 3 Jobeda Khatoon who is the divorced wife of defendant No. 1 Abdur Rahman obtained a decree in M S No. 31/46 of the Court of Munsif, Cox's Bazar for dower-debt and then purchased defendant, Abdur Rahman's share in the Money Execution Case No. 34/48 on 7-4-48; that in pursuance thereof obtained delivery of possession in the suit-land i.e. in Abdur Rahman's share after auction purchase. Subsequently she settled six kanis of land out of her auction purchased land with defendants No. 4-9 on 28-7-55 on the basis of a patta vide Ext. 1; that the defendants No. 4-9 possessed the said six kanis of land and thereafter defendant Nos. 4-6 and 8 sold their four kanis of land out of the said holding to the plaintiff on the basis of a registered kabala dated 24-12-58 vide Ext. 2; that plaintiffs vendor later on executed an antedated kabala in favour of the defendant No. 10 in respect of their share in the suit-land in collusion with defendant No. 1 Abdur Raham to defeat plaintiffs title; that the plaintiff possessed the suit-land but the same was wrongly recorded in the name of defendant No. 1 Abdur Rahman Hence the suit by the plaintiff for declaration of title and for partition and allotment of saham in respect of the said schedule of land of the plaint.
